execution.compute_note: The evaluator uses small 256-dimensional host-routed linear algebra, so requesting a GPU would waste accelerator capacity.

prediction_card.status: internally frozen before any checkpoint evaluation; not a public or external preregistration

all_current_guard_extractor.status: post-hoc reducer for a no-next-state guard emitted by the authenticated evaluator before execution; not the internally frozen primary reducer

global_k_support_closure_run_rows.csv.normalization: CSV values and row order are exact; CRLF line endings were normalized to LF.

global_k_support_closure_system_rows.csv.normalization: CSV values and row order are exact; CRLF line endings were normalized to LF.

global_k_support_closure_all_current_run.normalization: Deterministically extracted as LF-terminated CSV from the 45 authenticated raw shards.

global_k_support_closure_all_current_sys.normalization: Seed medians were recomputed per system from the compact all-current run rows.

global_k_support_closure_all_current_sou.normalization: Contains every raw shard and checkpoint digest plus a path-independent shard-roster digest.

protocol.null: sign-pair-preserving coordinate permutation applied jointly to z, z_next, and P while the learned global K remains fixed
protocol.aggregation: median across seeds within each system, then median across 15 systems
protocol.scope: one-step latent diagnostics after projecting the source state onto a fit-derived support, evaluated only on score transitions whose current and next supports route to the same retained family
protocol.future_conditioning: The persistent-family score population conditions on next-state family membership; it is not an autonomous deployment router and must be disclosed as future-conditioned.
protocol.all_current_guard_scope: The evaluator-emitted all-current guard retains every score transition whose current support routes to a retained family and never consults the next-state family. Its compact reduction was performed post hoc and is not a second internally frozen primary decision.
protocol.row_vector_convention: z_next is predicted as z @ K; P is diagonal, so cross-support leakage is z @ P @ K @ (I-P).
protocol.posthoc_restriction: P @ K @ P is evaluated diagnostically and is not fitted as a local map.

result.executed_decision_string_correction: The authenticated decision JSON repeats the frozen branch text 'claim invariant charts only.' That wording is overstrong and is superseded for every reviewer-facing use by this packet's stricter claim boundary: support-projected approximate one-step closure only, not an invariant chart or invariant subspace.

all_current_guard.status: post-hoc reduction of a pre-execution evaluator-emitted guard; not the internally frozen primary

claim_boundary.supported: Observed sparse supports are unusually closed under one support-projected application of the learned global K relative to the internally frozen matched coordinate-permutation null.
not_supported: the supports define invariant subspaces of the full autonomous global-K rollout
the restricted operators encode distinct local laws
the diagnostic improves decoded or multistep forecasting
the effect is specific to sparsity before the dense tanh cardinality-matched control completes
claim_boundary.sign_split_caveat: All systems are two-dimensional and the latent uses a sign-split ReLU construction with structurally exclusive positive/negative coordinate pairs; the null preserves those pairs, but architecture-specific closure remains a possible explanation.
